parentEvidence.interpretation: U3 v1 remains a frozen negative geometry result; U3b is a new confirmatory study generated from the post-hoc transfer-function diagnosis and does not revise U3 v1.

frozenPredictiveModel.rule: U1b coefficients and likelihood remain immutable; U3b changes only the deterministic uncertainty-to-fusion transfer.

hypothesis.primary: The held-out U1b confidence signal improves sparse 8-view dense CPU TSDF geometry when transferred as relative confidence precision rather than clipped absolute inverse variance.
hypothesis.mechanism: U3 v1 exposed that most samples are high confidence, where full and depth-only predictions coincide, while much of the low/medium confidence tail is compressed by the absolute 0.01 precision floor. U3b removes the absolute precision scale and tests only the confidence-conditioned precision ratio on new untouched rooms.

properties: high confidence c=1 has weight exactly 1
medium and low confidence are downweighted only by the frozen U1b confidence penalty
the absolute depth-noise scale cancels algebraically
no minimum precision floor is used
no scene-level or frame-level renormalization is used
the only numerical clamp permitted is [0,1] after the closed-form calculation to guard floating-point roundoff

methods.role: no-confidence baseline and algebraic depth-only control for the relative transfer

methods.weight: the frozen U3 v1 absolute inverse-variance mapping, unchanged
methods.role: legacy secondary reference only; cannot rescue or revise the U3 v1 primary result

methods.weight: relative-confidence-precision after deterministic within-scene confidence permutation
methods.permutation: flatten the selected 8-view confidence sequence in temporal/pixel row-major order; rank destination indices by SplitMix64(seed XOR linearIndex), stable ascending; assign the original confidence sequence to ranked destinations
methods.role: causal association control preserving each scene's exact confidence distribution

primaryComparison.bootstrapStatistic: median scene-level relative Chamfer improvement, (baseline - candidate) / baseline; percentile 95% interval
primaryComparison.decisionRule: All gate clauses must pass. Failure of any clause is a negative/null U3b confirmatory result.

dataRoles.sensorConfidence: ARKitScenes raw confidence for the exact video ID, joined by nearest timestamp within 20 ms
dataRoles.orientationWitnessOnly: ARKitScenes raw lowres_depth, used only to identify the exact no-interpolation dihedral orientation transform
dataRoles.cameraPose: CA-1M FARO-registered released camera-to-world pose after the same pose-convention preflight used in U3 v1
dataRoles.referenceGeometry: CA-1M FARO depth back-projected into registered scanner coordinates; never used to choose weights, frames, or transfer parameters

sidecarAssociation.orientationSelection: choose the transform minimizing median absolute difference between transformed ARKitScenes raw lowres_depth and CA-1M wide/depth over valid overlapping pixels
sidecarAssociation.orientationAcceptance: best median <=25 mm OR best <=75% of second-best; no interpolation

frameSelection.policy: deterministic temporal quantiles over complete structurally valid CA-1M frames, independent of confidence and FARO residuals
frameSelection.formula: for j in [0,7], select nearest index to j*(N-1)/7; exact half-index ties choose the lower original frame index

posePreflight.method: cross-project FARO depth between deterministic adjacent-frame pairs under released camera-to-world and inverse interpretations
posePreflight.passRule: released interpretation must have lower scene median cross-projection depth disagreement and win a majority of comparable adjacent-frame pairs in every confirmatory scene
posePreflight.failurePolicy: if any scene fails, stop before reconstruction and record an adapter/preflight failure; do not change the scene set

volumeAndReference.implementation: dense CPU TSDF research path using the same projection, truncation and meshing implementation as U3 v1
volumeAndReference.referenceDownsampling: stable SHA-256 rank over scene/frame/pixel identity after fixed stride; retain lexicographically lowest digests
volumeAndReference.fairness: Within a scene all methods reuse identical frames, poses, depth, confidence locations, volume bounds, voxel size, truncation, FARO reference and mesh extraction. Only the per-sample fusion weight differs.

executionOrder: 1. Commit this protocol and the confirmatory split before downloading any selected confirmatory CA-1M archive or ARKitScenes confidence/lowres_depth sidecar.
2. Acquire exactly the five frozen confirmatory CA-1M validation archives and exactly their ARKitScenes confidence + lowres_depth sidecars; record acquisition ledger and hashes.
3. Run the frozen pose-convention preflight on all five scenes. If any scene fails, stop before reconstruction.
4. Prepare exact 8-view manifests, shared volume bounds, deterministic shuffled confidence, and FARO reference clouds without producing reconstruction metrics.
5. Optionally run weight-distribution diagnostics on prepared inputs only; diagnostics may not change this protocol, weights, scenes or thresholds.
6. Execute all five methods once on every scene in fixed order: uniform, naive-confidence, u3v1-absolute-inverse-variance, relative-confidence-precision, relative-confidence-shuffled.
7. Evaluate each mesh against the frozen FARO reference with no alignment and write one immutable primary-result artifact.
8. Compute the 2,000-replicate paired scene bootstrap once. Do not refit U1b or alter the transfer after seeing any confirmatory geometry outcome.

claimPolicy.ifPassed: May claim that the frozen U1b confidence signal, transferred as relative confidence precision, improves 8-view dense CPU TSDF metric geometry over naive ARKit confidence on this untouched five-room confirmatory set. The claim remains scoped to this representation, sensor/data regime and sample size.
claimPolicy.ifFailed: Report U3b as negative/null. Do not tune the equation on these five exposed confirmatory rooms. Any further transfer redesign requires another prospectively frozen untouched evaluation set.
claimPolicy.u3v1Status: Always remains negative regardless of U3b outcome.
claimPolicy.u4Gate: Do not use Gaussian rendering quality to override a failed dense-geometry confirmatory result.
